certified-trophy-sample.note: SAMPLE CT (belt promotion: band uses the belt colour, orange shown). Certified cues: gold cup, gold seal rosette with sky ribbons, warm halo, sparkles, cream date plate. BLANK plate: the game writes 'Earned {date}' (C7 trophyText).

layers.note: cup + stand + plinth + blank date plate + halo + sparkles, one layer. Belt band orange in this sample.
school palette picks the file; unknown school -> default (gold + sky)
PLACEHOLDER is a stand-in only; never ship it. No school logo is in the repo yet.

schoolMarkSpec.supplyAs: square PNG, 128x128 (min 64x64), RGBA with transparent background, sRGB, mark centred
schoolMarkSpec.safeArea: keep all of the mark inside the centred circle of diameter 112 px (8 px margin on a 128 canvas); outside that is clipped by the face ring
schoolMarkSpec.rules: no text smaller than the mark itself (it shows at 16 px); bold simple shapes; no red (house rule); test on the seal face colour of your palette
schoolMarkSpec.palette: backing colours: scallop, face, faceRing, tail (hex). Defaults: #d68c14 #ffd34d #fff5be #4096eb

default.source: A3 house palette (generic fallback, unchanged from PR #138)
